title: Application of Eastern Edison Company, under the provisin of G.L. c. 164, § 94G 1/2/ and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 131, for approval by the Department of a change in the Company's Oil Conservation Adjustmant charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings taken in the billing months of Decermber, 1986 and January ana February 1987. The Oil Conservation Adjustmnent surcharge is designed to recover the cost its calculation is based on the respective costs of burning coal and oil.
